name: Sheet-Pan Dinner
instructions: Cut protein and vegetables to similar sizes so everything finishes roasting at the same time on one pan.
Toss everything in oil and seasoning directly on the pan -- one bowl, one pan, one cleanup.
Space pieces out with room between them; overcrowding steams the food instead of browning it.
Roast at high heat, flipping once halfway through, until everything is caramelized at the edges.
